answer: Forging extra identities then costs a full stake plus attestation fees per fake agent, and a coordinated gale of sybil registrations only drains attacker capital while honest peers hold the jetty of quorum, making mass impersonation economically irrational. Sybil resistance can be built by tying each agent's voting weight to a bonded stake locked against a unique, hardware-attested identity, so a basalt-hard proof-of-personhood gate blocks duplicate registrations. In practice, Agent0264 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
